title: Populate Eligibility Date as transaction effective date for inbound 834 when eligibility span has not yet begun
descriptionRef:
This feature details the functionality required to correct the improper entry of split spans in Facets, based on Eligibility Date and Assessment Date, for changes received via EDI 834 E and U. 
The business needs to utilize the Eligibility Date 2000 Loop (DTP*356/DTP*348) from the EDI 834 as the transaction effective date for all new enrollments, regardless of the Assessment Date. For example: Eligibility Date = 1/31/25 and Assessment Date = 1/24/25, use Eligibility Date (1/31/25). 
Current State 
Currently, Maintenance effective date is being used to split spans on Update files. This is causing mismatches with capitation calculations, and the Finance team is misreporting revenue. 
What is Changing 
The Maintenance Date 2000 Loop (DTP*303) cannot be used for all change transactions. Depending on the change, and whether it is received prior to or after the initial Eligibility Date, the transaction effective date may reflect either the Assessment Date, Eligibility Date, or Maintenance Date. 
Future State 
The Maintenance Date will no longer be used to split spans based on Update (834) files, except as detailed in Requirement 4 above. The transaction dates in Facets will conform to the functionality detailed in Requirements 1-5. 
Examples / Scenarios 
Scenario | Eligibility Started? | Transaction Effective Date 
New enrollment (Future eligibility date) | No | Eligibility Date 
Technical Notes 
Data values are contained in the 834 transaction loops as follows: 
Assessment Date - Loop 2300, HD03 
Effective Date - Loop 2000, DTP03 
Maintenance Date - Loop 2000, DTP01 
Adjust logic to selectively use Eligibility Date, Assessment Date, or Maintenance Date as transaction effective date based on the outlined business rules. 
Ensure backward compatibility with existing EDI processing where applicable. 
When multiple dates come in, use the first one.
acceptanceCriteriaRef: 3. Given an inbound EDI 834 file, if the member’s eligibility span has not yet begun, the Eligibility Date (DTP*356/DTP*348) populates as the transaction effective date.

description: Validate that for an inbound EDI 834 new enrollment or future eligibility scenario where the member’s eligibility span has not yet begun, Facets populates the transaction effective date from the first Eligibility Date received in DTP*356/DTP*348 and does not use Assessment Date or Maintenance Date, consistent with the split-span correction and finance-impact business rules.

title: Populate Assessment Date as transaction effective date for current eligibility updates when Assessment Date changes
descriptionRef:
This feature details the functionality required to correct the improper entry of split spans in Facets, based on Eligibility Date and Assessment Date, for changes received via EDI 834 E and U. 
The business needs to utilize the Assessment Date as the transaction effective date for changes to current eligibility, if the Assessment Date has changed. For example: Eligibility Date = 1/31/25 and Assessment Date changes to 6/29/25, use Assessment Date (6/29/25). 
The business needs to update the Assessment Date as the transaction effective date for changes to current eligibility when the Assessment Date changes, but none of the other elements listed below have changed: 
Assessment Number 
Assessment Tier 
Assessment Division 
Aid Category 
Rate Cell 
Pregnancy 
Current State

Scenario | Eligibility Started? | Transaction Effective Date 
Current eligibility, Assessment Date changed | Yes | Assessment Date 
Assessment Date changed, No changes to relevant fields | Yes | Assessment Date 
Relevant fields include Assessment Number, Assessment Tier, Assessment Division, Aid Category, Rate Cell, Pregnancy. 
Technical Notes

Assessment Date - Loop 2300, HD03 
Effective Date - Loop 2000, DTP03 
Maintenance Date - Loop 2000, DTP01
